description_en: Modifies the SSL settings of RDS Supabase instances in batches
description_zh: 该接口用于批量修改RDS AI应用实例的SSL配置
kebab_example: aliyun rdsai modify-instances-ssl --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-names ra-supabase-xxx --ssl-enabled 1 --ca-type custom --server-cert -----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE-----MIID00000QqEP-----END_CERTIFICATE----- --server-key -----BEGIN_PRIVATE_KEY-----MIIE0000ihfg==-----END_PRIVATE_KEY----- --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstancesSSL

parameters.help_en: The information about the RDS Supabase instances that you want to configure. You can specify up to 10 instances
parameters.help_zh: AI应用的实例ID列表。最多支持10个
parameters.name: instance_names

parameters.help_en:
Enables or disables SSL. Valid values:

*   **1**: enable
*   **0**: disable
parameters.help_zh:
开启或关闭SSL，取值：
* **1**：开启
* **0**：关闭
parameters.name: ssl_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The certificate type. Only **custom** is supported.

>  This parameter is required if **SSLEnabled** is set to **1**
parameters.help_zh:
证书类型，当前仅支持**custom**，表示使用自定义证书。
> **SSLEnabled**为**1**时，此参数必须配置
parameters.name: ca_type

parameters.help_en:
The content of the custom certificate.

>  This parameter is required if **CAType** is set to **custom**
parameters.help_zh:
自定义证书内容。

> **CAType**为**custom**时，此参数必须配置
parameters.name: server_cert

parameters.help_en:
The private key of the certificate.

>  This parameter is required if **CAType** is set to **custom**
parameters.help_zh:
证书私钥。

> **CAType**为**custom**时，此参数必须配置
parameters.name: server_key
